name: LocalOps API
description:
API for programmatically managing LocalOps environments and services.

Every successful response (except `GET /health` and `DELETE /v1/environments/{envId}/services/{serviceId}`) is wrapped in an envelope: `{ "message": "success", "data": { ... } }`. Errors are returned unwrapped as `{ "error_code": "...", "message": "...", "errors": [...] }`.

Deploys, deletes, secret writes and custom domain deploys are asynchronous. A 2xx confirms that the request was accepted and passed synchronous validation - observe the outcome by polling deployment state, service state or custom domain state.

Endpoints badged **COMING SOON** are not live yet. Their request and response shapes are published so you can plan an integration, and may change before release - calls to those paths return `404` today.
